correctness.rationale: Every unordered configuration is contained in exactly one convex distinct-arm polygon or sorted same-arm triangle. Radial expansion in the former and a shared-boundary-compatible homotopy in the latter yield a global strong deformation retract onto outer polygons; terminal short-arm segments collapse to the literally embedded filtered incidence graph. Thus all persistence inclusions commute up to an objectwise homotopy equivalence, including all threshold equalities. The resulting graph is a subdivision of K_m with leaves and isolated points, proving integral homology ranks and the full H0/H1 barcodes with elder-rule ties. Exact-rational chain computations on 7,065 actual polyhedral examples and 10,000 union-find barcode tests support, but are not needed for the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The leading 2026 source constructs an ordered weighted-graph filtration with vertices (x,y), and its vertex-edge data are invariant under coordinate exchange. Thus the associated unlabeled quotient incidence graph is not independently claimed as original. The explicit arbitrary-real-vector unlabeled *barcode formula*, including all 0-dimensional pair-sum lifetimes, exact equality conventions, and complete 1-dimensional multiplicities, is not stated in Li–Özaydın §§1–4/Appendix A, Deeley 2011, Dover–Özaydın 2013, or Li 2023. The pre-existing ordered graph construction is the strongest close source: equivariant quotient plus graph persistence can derive the result, so novelty is limited to that explicit complete determination and direct proof, with residual risk of an unpublished or unindexed identical formula.
residual_risks: The graph model is a straightforward quotient of the ordered model of Li–Özaydın 2026, and it is not itself claimed novel. Their results plus the equivariant quotient and elementary graph persistence yield the barcode as a computable corollary; a future finding that the full explicit interval formula was already given elsewhere would remove originality.
Published-index retrieval and bounded literature searches cannot exclude unindexed equivalent results, dissertations, or unpublished work.
The later 2026 Munawar Khan paper was checked at abstract level only; it studies unrestrained Borel–Moore unordered configurations, rather than distance-dependent metric-star barcodes.

value.rationale: The natural problem of interchangeable agents maintaining a minimum distance on an arbitrarily weighted junction network motivates the unlabeled configuration space. Unlike ordinary pointwise Betti ranks or a standard substitution, the result determines every component merger and cycle lifetime uniformly over arbitrary real lengths: 0-dimensional finite birth thresholds are pair sums, while all 1-dimensional essential birth thresholds are individual ordered lengths with explicit multiplicities. This precise separation of geometric controls provides a complete benchmark for metric topological robotics and graph configuration persistence, without implying a broader unsupported application theorem.
